display_long_description:
Weather Now turns your Meta Quest into the most relaxing way to check the **forecast**. Get accurate, real-time conditions, detailed hourly and **10-day forecasts**, animated **radar**, and severe weather **alerts** — all in a clean, comfortable VR interface designed for quick daily check-ins.

# FEATURES
- **Current conditions** with temperature, "feels like," humidity, wind, UV index, and air quality
- Hour-by-hour forecasts for the next 24 hours
- 10-day extended outlook with highs, lows, and precipitation chances
- Animated **weather** radar so you can watch fronts and storms move
- Severe weather alerts for your saved locations
- Sunrise, sunset, and moon-phase data
- Search and save unlimited locations worldwide
- Imperial or metric units

# DESIGNED FOR QUEST
- Comfortable, low-motion UI — safe for any user
- Crisp text and high-contrast layouts optimized for VR readability
- Quick-launch shortcuts so you can check the forecast in seconds
- Works seated, standing, or in any play area

Whether you're planning your day, tracking incoming **storms**, or just enjoying a moment with the sky around you, Weather gives you the information you need at a glance. No ads cluttering your view. No motion sickness. Just clear forecasts, anywhere in the world.

Free to download. Open it in the morning, before a session, or whenever you want to know what the sky is doing.
